users.makeAdminConfirm: {name} will be able to manage all accounts and site settings.
users.selfDemote: You will lose administrator access and be signed out.
users.deleteConfirm: {name} and all of their linked accounts, clients and tokens will be deleted. This can't be undone.
users.selfDelete: Your own account will be deleted and you will be signed out. This can't be undone.

config.description: Site settings, email delivery, CAPTCHA and sign-in providers.
config.callbackHint: Register exactly this URL with the provider.
config.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current value
config.fixFields: Some values are invalid. Check the highlighted fields.
config.providerText: OAuth credentials for signing in and linking with {name}.

groups.smtpText: SMTP server for verification, reset and sign-in code emails.
groups.capText: Self-hosted CAP verification. Enable it alone or alongside Turnstile.
groups.captchaText: Enable each provider independently. Preference and failover apply when both are enabled.

fields.registrationHint: When off, new accounts can't be created by any method.
fields.refreshCooldownHint: Minutes between refreshes of a linked account name, 1–43200.
fields.turnstileHint: Both keys must be set before turning this on.
fields.capHint: Set the instance URL and both keys before enabling CAP.
fields.capAssetHint: Self-hosted mode loads /assets/widget.js from the instance. Enable asset serving on your CAP server first.
fields.captchaPreferredHint: Used first when both providers are enabled. When only one is enabled, that provider is used.
fields.captchaFailoverHint: Applies when both providers are enabled. Loading or service failures switch to a fresh challenge from the other provider. Rejected proofs never bypass verification.

notices.description: Announcements shown on the overview page.
notices.createText: The newest three notices appear on the overview; pinned notices come first.
notices.allowedTags: Allowed: p, br, strong, em, b, i, u, s, code, pre, blockquote, ul, ol, li, a, h1–h6, span. Other markup is removed.
notices.deleteConfirm: “{title}” will be removed from the site.

showcase.description: Entries listed on the public showcase page.
showcase.iconHint: Optional. Square image over HTTP or HTTPS.
showcase.deleteConfirm: {name} will be removed from the showcase.
